dialogues.jp: 「はっくしょん！」
思いっきりくしゃみ。花粉か？
dialogues.en: I've suddenly started sneezing. The pollen, maybe?
dialogues.text: I've suddenly started sneezing. The pollen, maybe?

dialogues.jp: 「……ていうか、寒いのかも」

歩いていれば心地のいい春の空気も、ただベン
チに座っているだけでは、じわじわと体温を奪っ
ていく。
dialogues.en:
When walking, the spring temperature is just right, but just
sitting and not moving around left me scrambling for warmth.
dialogues.text:
When walking, the spring temperature is just right, but just
sitting and not moving around left me scrambling for warmth.

dialogues.jp: 「はあくっしょん！」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「くすくす……凄い、くしゃみですね」

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「だね」

ずるずると鼻をすすりながら顔を上げると、そ
こにはティッシュを手にしたことりの姿が。
dialogues.en:
I lifted my head as I my nose sniffed unconciously, to the
sight of Kotori handing me a tissue.
dialogues.text:
I lifted my head as I my nose sniffed unconciously, to the
sight of Kotori handing me a tissue.

dialogues.jp:
そしてその後ろには、相変わらず爽やかな笑み
を浮かべた工藤が立っていた。
dialogues.en: And next to her was Kudou, ever-smiling.
dialogues.text: And next to her was Kudou, ever-smiling.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はい、どうぞ」

ニッコリと微笑んで、ポケットティッシュを渡
してきてくれる。
dialogues.en: Grinning, Kotori passed me a few pocket tissues.
dialogues.text: Grinning, Kotori passed me a few pocket tissues.

dialogues.jp: 「ん、さんきゅ」
ち〜ん！

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……見ませんよ」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「桜の花粉で、ピンク色になっているかもしれ
　ないからさ」
dialogues.en: "I didn't know sakura pollen was pink in colour."
dialogues.text: "I didn't know sakura pollen was pink in colour."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「からさって、そんな……宝物でも見せるよう
　に」
dialogues.en: "That's... like looking for treasure, isn't it?
dialogues.text: "That's... like looking for treasure, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「残念」
くしゃっと丸め、屑カゴへと捨てる。
dialogues.en:
I rolled up the tissue in a ball and threw it in a nearby
trash bin.
dialogues.text:
I rolled up the tissue in a ball and threw it in a nearby
trash bin.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何やってるんですか？　こんなところで」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、何となく。春だし、外に出たら気持ち
　いいかなって」
dialogues.en:
"Nothing much. It's spring after all, when being outdoors
feels great."
dialogues.text:
"Nothing much. It's spring after all, when being outdoors
feels great."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そう言うことり達こそ、何やってるんだよ？」
dialogues.en: "What about you two? What are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "What about you two? What are you doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私達ですか？」

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉と一緒だよ。天気がいいなって外に出た
　ら」
dialogues.en:
"Same as you. The weather was good, so we went out to enjoy
it."
dialogues.text:
"Same as you. The weather was good, so we went out to enjoy
it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そこでバッタリ会ったんです」
dialogues.en: "And we just happened to bump into each other."
dialogues.text: "And we just happened to bump into each other."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ふ〜ん」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「その顔、何か疑ってますね？」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「べっつにぃ」

俺とことり達がこうして会ったみたいに、そう
言う偶然もあるだろう。
dialogues.en: She says that them meeting me was a complete coincidence.
dialogues.text: She says that them meeting me was a complete coincidence.

dialogues.jp: なんせ狭い島だからな。

唇に指をあて、ジッと俺の瞳を覗き込んでいた
ことりが、にこっと微笑む。
dialogues.en:
With a finger on her lips, Kotori stared into my eyes for
awhile, then suddenly pulled back and smiled.
dialogues.text:
With a finger on her lips, Kotori stared into my eyes for
awhile, then suddenly pulled back and smiled.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「疑ってないんだったら、別にいいです」
dialogues.en: "Well, if you're not being skeptic, then it's fine."
dialogues.text: "Well, if you're not being skeptic, then it's fine."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なんだかな」
ことりの不思議な雰囲気に苦笑する。
dialogues.en: The only thing that Kotori gave was a mysterious smile.
dialogues.text: The only thing that Kotori gave was a mysterious smile.

dialogues.jp:
「それにしても、こんなに気持ちのいい春空の
　下を、みんな｛そろ／揃｝って無意味に｛はいかい／徘徊｝かぁ」
dialogues.en:
"In any case, it's amazing, everyone with nothing to do in
this feel-good Sunday under the blue sky..."
dialogues.text:
"In any case, it's amazing, everyone with nothing to do in
this feel-good Sunday under the blue sky..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……散歩って言ってくださいよ」
dialogues.en: "...I did say we were taking a walk."
dialogues.text: "...I did say we were taking a walk."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ま、似たようなもんだろ」
dialogues.en: "Well, is that really something to do?"
dialogues.text: "Well, is that really something to do?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「意味的にはかなり違うと思うぞ」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うんうん」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「２対１。……俺の負けか」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いや、勝負でもないと思うんですけど」
dialogues.en: "Heyy, it's not a battle or anything."
dialogues.text: "Heyy, it's not a battle or anything."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、俺もそう思うんだけどな」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……とりあえず、散歩でもするか？　ここで
　立ち話してるのもなんだし」
dialogues.en:
"...Anyway, want to just take a walk? No point just standing
around here talking."
dialogues.text:
"...Anyway, want to just take a walk? No point just standing
around here talking."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「だね」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ですね」
３人並んで歩き出す。
dialogues.en: The three of us started walking together.
dialogues.text: The three of us started walking together.

dialogues.jp: と、その時。
さあ……っと。

花の匂いを含んだ風が吹いてきた。ことりの髪
がふわりと浮かぶ。
dialogues.en:
The sweet scent of sakura petals could be smelled, as a
sudden gust of wind blew them past us, and through Kotori's
hair.
dialogues.text:
The sweet scent of sakura petals could be smelled, as a
sudden gust of wind blew them past us, and through Kotori's
hair.

dialogues.jp:
ほっそりとした指で髪を押さえ、ことりが屈託
なく笑う。
dialogues.en:
Kotori controlled her hair with her fingers, all the while
wearing a carefree grin.
dialogues.text:
Kotori controlled her hair with her fingers, all the while
wearing a carefree grin.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……気持ちいいですよね、春って」

俺はそんなことりを見つめ、微笑みながら頷い
た。
dialogues.en:
I look towards Kotori and gave her a sly grin while nodding
my head.
dialogues.text:
I look towards Kotori and gave her a sly grin while nodding
my head.

dialogues.jp:
「風でこう、微妙に翻ったスカートとかたまら
　ないよな」
dialogues.en:
"Better be more careful of the wind's effect on your skirt
rather than on your hair."
dialogues.text:
"Better be more careful of the wind's effect on your skirt
rather than on your hair."

dialogues.jp: ことりと、なぜか工藤に｛にら／睨｝まれた。
dialogues.en:
Kotori, for some reason, started scowling at Kudou on my
remark.
dialogues.text:
Kotori, for some reason, started scowling at Kudou on my
remark.

dialogues.jp: ◆みんなで散歩◆

たまたま出会ったことり、工藤と一緒に、公園
の中を散歩する事になった。
ひとりでぶらつくより、よっぽど楽しいよな。
dialogues.en: Compared to walking about alone, it was far more enjoyable.
dialogues.text: Compared to walking about alone, it was far more enjoyable.
